Not only can you create unearthly overdrive and fuzz sounds by routing the first channel into the second, but there are 5 additional options on the second channel to give you a huge range of wild, filtered, modulated, and blasted out overdrive / fuzz tones. A pleasant boost, a squealing lead, a chopped out glitch, a jet rocket lift-off; this is the pedal to blast your sound into the cosmos!
